methodology.actions: alternate accounts; rotate save/progress/remove; verify complete library read-back; reader document
methodology.pacing: 500ms after each action; library mutation action includes read-back
limitations: Two synthetic accounts with at most one saved item each, current published catalog, one reader title.
Sequential closed-loop timing is not the concurrent mixed workload or full capacity envelope.
Reader document HTTP completion does not measure browser rendering.
First requests retained; this run does not independently classify cold versus hot starts.
Setup, health, and deployment-identity checks are outside the 300 measured requests.
